clearer_why: B gives every edge its own line and label (verify, browse, checkout each leave the gateway separately; settled, card, placed each run on their own), with larger text and cylinder shapes for the stores. In A, verify/browse share one horizontal trunk, settled and card share a line out of Payments, and the dashed 'placed' edge detours left through the Checkout core box, so it is harder to tell which arrow goes where.
looks_why: A is compact, fits in one view, has a neat card style and an orange accent tracing the checkout-to-charge path. B looks plainer and wireframe-like, with long empty vertical runs (Auth/Catalog down to Redis) that make it twice as tall.
weak_A: shared edge trunks and the looping 'placed' dashed edge crossing the core group
weak_B: tall and sparse, with long vertical runs spreading over two screens
